name: Pan-Seared Barramundi / Roasted Red Snapper with Crushed Potatoes (Captain's Gala Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · 1923 / Disney Wonder & Magic · Captain's Gala Menu
whyItWorks: Mild, flaky white barramundi or red snapper over crushed olive-oil potatoes is ultra-lean, low-residue, and easy to digest.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the fish pan-seared in olive oil with salt only (sauce on the side, no lemon) over crushed or mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Confirm sauce on the side contains no citrus
